content.short: Small business checking, invoices and payments.
content.description: Novo is a US business banking platform for small businesses, entrepreneurs, and freelancers, offering fee-free business checking with a focus on simplicity and integrations. Through a partner bank it provides a business checking account, a debit card, free invoicing, ACH and check payments, Novo Reserves for setting money aside, and deep connections to tools like Stripe, Shopify, QuickBooks, and other platforms that small businesses rely on. Novo emphasizes fast onboarding, no monthly fees or minimums, and a clean dashboard that ties banking to the apps businesses already use to get paid and operate. By combining no-fee checking with invoicing and a rich integration ecosystem, Novo positions itself as an accessible financial hub for early-stage and main-street businesses.
content.meta: Novo is fee-free US business checking with invoicing, payments, and integrations. Discover Novo and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
